style: soft 3D cartoon, top-down, warm and friendly
themeWhy: the whole one the pieces are cut from is the chapter's milk-chocolate piece, so the keys are chocolate brown with a raspberry Enter, butter-caramel soft keys and a cream panel (same as the sibling slots); never red, never violet.

images.why: Wrong (phase 1) 'a piece of the right size drawn under it, the amber tenth first, the rose hundredth next and the sky blue thousandth last, so the pieces get smaller as the columns travel right'; Look/Stage 'the pieces get smaller': the one whole under each column is the chapter's chocolate piece (drawn once per whole at its box, and once more for the zoomed hundredth), with the ten strips, the hundred cells, the slivers, their cut lines and the amber, rose and sky tints drawn in code on top.
images.prompt: One single square of milk chocolate in a warm milk-chocolate brown, with a glossy top, a soft bevelled edge and a gentle highlight in one corner.
